title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Early Show) on 1970-02-13
taper: Thanks to Dwight Holmes for providing the cassette source
source: 5th gen aud casette from unknown source > WAV

ai_review.summary: A rough audience recording with harsh, cloudy sound and missing sections; the only highlighted performance is a Black Peter that the reviewer plans to air.
ai_review.review: The two fan reviews agree that the audio quality is sub‑par – described as harsh, cloudy and not comparable to better‑recorded shows. The tape is incomplete, though one listener was pleased enough to feature Black Peter on their radio program. No performance details beyond that song are provided.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers criticize the recording, with one giving it a single star and another a modest three; no positive comments on musical performance aside from Black Peter, leading to an overall low‑mid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Harsh and cloudy sound, missing portions of the show, not up to the level of better‑recorded (Late Show) tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Recording is incomplete; no comments on overall set pacing or flow.
